name: Vertical gaming clip
description: Short / TikTok taken from a match or a live stream: a single highlight, 15-60 s, reframed to 9:16.
structure: the moment, with just enough context (2-5 s before) → the reaction → punchline
rules:
# Vertical gaming clip
- A single moment (win, fail, reaction, one-liner), 15 to 60 s, hook from the very first second.
- Just enough context beforehand to understand it, then the reaction all the way through. No outro.
- Horizontal reframing on the action or the facecam (the shot's `cadrage_horizontal`); important HUD elements must stay visible.
- Big subtitles, few words at a time, above the bottom HUD.
- The game audio stays present; one sound effect or one zoom on the peak of the moment, no more.
